sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗，《纽约时报》为您报道。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: The mayor, the president, and the alleged quid pro quo that has plunged the Justice Department and now New York's political world into chaos.
sentences.zh: 市长、总统，以及据称的利益交换，让司法部乃至如今纽约的政治世界陷入混乱。

sentences.en: My colleague, Nick Fandos, walks us through the saga.
sentences.zh: 我的同事尼克·凡多斯带我们梳理这场风波。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月20日，星期四。

sentences.en: Nick, nice to have you in the studio.
sentences.zh: 尼克，欢迎来到演播室。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你来。

sentences.en: It's always good to be back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能回来。

sentences.en: So if you live in New York City long enough, and you almost qualify for this, you come to know the famous phrase from Cindy Adams, the legendary tabloid columniSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你在纽约市住得够久——你差不多也快符合这个条件了——你就会知道传奇小报专栏作家辛迪·亚当斯的那句名言。

sentences.en: Only in New York, kids.
sentences.zh: 只有在纽约，孩子们。

sentences.en: Only in New York.
sentences.zh: 只有在纽约。

sentences.en: And that seems to apply to the events of the past week or so when our Democratic mayor, indicted on sweeping federal corruption charges
sentences.zh: 这似乎适用于过去一周左右发生的事件：我们的民主党市长被控犯有一系列联邦腐败罪，

sentences.en: that would seem to spell the end of his career, suddenly wins a reprieve from the Republican president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 这些罪名本应宣告他政治生涯的终结，却突然从美国共和党总统那里获得了暂缓起诉。

sentences.en: But then, as the terms of this reprieve become public, it creates this extraordinary blowback that extends far beyond our fair city.
sentences.zh: 但是随后，随着这项暂缓起诉的条款公之于众，它引发了巨大的反弹，其影响远远超出了我们美丽的城市。

sentences.en: That's where you pick up.
sentences.zh: 这就是你切入的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, as usual, Ms. Adams, I think, is correct.
sentences.zh: 嗯，像往常一样，亚当斯女士说得对，我想。

sentences.en: But Mr. Adams, that is Mayor Eric Adams, I want to make the argument while I'm here today that his case is much bigger than New York City.
sentences.zh: 但亚当斯先生，也就是埃里克·亚当斯市长，我今天在这里想说的是，他的案子远比纽约市本身重大得多。

sentences.en: Because what has happened over the last couple of weeks as the Justice Department has taken up and intervened and now moved to dismiss his case,
sentences.zh: 因为在过去几周里，随着司法部介入、干预并随后着手撤销他的案件，

sentences.en: it's set off two different crises at once.
sentences.zh: 这同时引发了两次不同的危机。

sentences.en: I think one of them is for the Justice Department because in moving to dismiss this case, they have set off a series of resignations and really a very large-scale conflict
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一次是针对司法部的，因为在寻求撤销此案的过程中，他们引发了一系列辞职潮，并且引发了非常大规模的冲突，

sentences.en: over the kind of traditional role of the department versus what President Trump wants to do with it, to use it to advance his agenda in all kinds of different realMs.
sentences.zh: 涉及司法部的传统角色与特朗普总统想要如何利用司法部——在各个不同领域利用它来推进其政治议程——之间的冲突。

sentences.en: And at the same time, for Mayor Adams back here in New York City, it's set off a real crisis of confidence about, is the guy in charge of our city running it
sentences.zh: 与此同时，对于回到纽约市的亚当斯市长来说，这也引发了一场真正的信任危机：掌管我们城市的这家伙，他的管理究竟是不是

sentences.en: in the best interest of the citizens, or is he now beholden to President Trump in Washington?
sentences.zh: 为了市民的最佳利益，还是说他现在效忠于华盛顿的特朗普总统？

sentences.en: And right now, there's a whole lot of people trying to figure out what to do about that.
sentences.zh: 而现在，有非常多的人正在琢磨该拿这怎么办。

sentences.en: I think we should take these crises one at a time,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该逐一处理这些危机，

sentences.en: starting with the crisis that this has triggered inside the Department of Justice, where, as you said, the story has been resignation.
sentences.zh: 首先从这在司法部内部引发的危机开始，正如你所说，这个故事的主题就是辞职。

sentences.en: So take us in that crisis and why this has felt like a crisis to folks inside the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们了解一下那场危机，以及为什么这让司法部内部的人感到这是一场危机。

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I think to explain that, I want to step back just slightly and remind listeners that last September, the Department of Justice
sentences.zh: 是的，嗯，我认为为了解释这一点，我想稍微后退一步，提醒听众，去年9月，司法部

sentences.en: and the United States Attorney in Manhattan brought federal charges on bribery and corruption against Eric AdaMs.
sentences.zh: 和曼哈顿联邦检察官对埃里克·亚当斯提出了贿赂和腐败的联邦指控。

sentences.en: And the charges essentially allege that he was taking bribes and kickbacks from Turkey in exchange for official favors.
sentences.zh: 这些指控基本上称，他一直在收受来自土耳其的贿赂和回扣，以换取官方的优待。

sentences.en: The nation of Turkey.
sentences.zh: 土耳其国家。

sentences.en: The nation of Turkey.
sentences.zh: 土耳其国家。

sentences.en: And the indictment laid out pretty strong evidence.
sentences.zh: 起诉书列出了相当有力的证据。

sentences.en: They had text messages, other communications, testimony from people around the mayor, making a pretty strong case that this behavior had occurred.
sentences.zh: 他们掌握了短信、其他通讯记录、市长身边人的证词，拼凑出了一个相当有力的证据链，证明这种行为确实发生过。

sentences.en: But Eric Adams has insisted throughout that he's innocent.
sentences.zh: 但埃里克·亚当斯一直坚称自己是无辜的。

sentences.en: And last fall, he recognized something important was happening.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，他意识到正在发生一件重要的事情。

sentences.en: Donald Trump was marching back to the White House.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普正大步重返白宫。

sentences.en: And given Trump's own aggrieved view of the justice system, that he was targeted for political reasons,
sentences.zh: 鉴于特朗普对司法系统一贯的满腹牢骚和委屈视角——即他因为政治原因遭到针对——

sentences.en: Adams begins to kind of curry favor with Trump.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯开始变相讨好特朗普。

sentences.en: Right, and suggests that they are kindred spirits in their journey with the justice system.
sentences.zh: 没错，并暗示他们在与司法系统的经历上是同路人。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the president seems to pick up and agree on this.
sentences.zh: 总统似乎也注意到了这一点并表示赞同。

sentences.en: They meet down in Florida for lunch.
sentences.zh: 他们在佛罗里达共进午餐。

sentences.en: Adams attends Trump's inauguration.
sentences.zh: 亚当斯出席了特朗普的就职典礼。

sentences.en: There's a developing kind of rapport between them.
sentences.zh: 他们之间正在建立一种默契。

sentences.en: And so in the first days that Trump is in office, the mayor's lawyers write to the president and ask for a pardon.
sentences.zh: 因此，在特朗普上任的第一天，市长的律师就写信给总统请求特赦。

sentences.en: They want these charges to just completely go away.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这些指控彻底消失。

sentences.en: They don't get a pardon, but what they got last week was a letter from the Justice Department to prosecutors here in New York saying, it's time for you to dismiss these charges.
sentences.zh: 他们没有得到特赦，但上周他们得到的是司法部写给纽约检察官的一封信，信中说：是时候撤销这些指控了。

sentences.en: Basically, the mothership of the Justice Department is saying to the New York City wing of the Justice Department, this is over, drop the case.
sentences.zh: 基本上，司法部的总部在对司法部驻纽约市的分支机构说：这事结束了，撤案吧。

sentences.en: Right, and there's two things that's interesting about this.
sentences.zh: 没错，这里有两个有趣的地方。

sentences.en: One is who's running that mothership right now.
sentences.zh: 一个是现在是谁在掌管那个总部。

sentences.en: It's none other than one of President Trump's former personal lawyers, Emile Beauvais.
sentences.zh: 正是特朗普总统的前私人律师之一埃米尔·博韦。

sentences.en: And the second thing is what he pens in this letter.
sentences.zh: 第二点是他在信中写了什么。

sentences.en: Rather than making this decision based on the evidence of the case, saying, oh, we don't actually think this is worthy of such grave charges,
sentences.zh: 他没有根据案件证据做出这个决定，比如“哦，我们实际上认为这不值得受到如此严重的指控”，

sentences.en: or we don't think that you can prove it.
sentences.zh: 或者“我们认为你们无法证明这一点”。

sentences.en: He says, no, no, no, we're not commenting on all of that.
sentences.zh: 他说：不，不，不，我们不对所有这些发表评论。

sentences.en: The reason for us to act is that this case is impeding Mayor Adams from helping implement the president's immigration agenda, from helping the president deport
sentences.zh: 我们采取行动的原因是，这个案件正在阻碍亚当斯市长协助落实总统的移民议程，阻碍总统驱逐

sentences.en: undocumented immigrants who have committed crimes or otherwise threatening Americans.
sentences.zh: 犯下罪行或对美国人构成其他威胁的无证移民。

sentences.en: That's a pretty shocking thing to read in an official
sentences.zh: 在官方的

sentences.en: Justice Department memo because the tradition in the Justice Department is that you make decisions based on the evidence, not on...
sentences.zh: 司法部备忘录里读到这样的话真是令人震惊，因为司法部的传统是根据证据做出决定，而不是根据……

sentences.en: And the law, not on political aims like that.
sentences.zh: 还有法律，而不是像这样的政治目标。

sentences.en: The other thing about this letter is that Beauvais makes clear these charges may not actually go away.
sentences.zh: 关于这封信的另一点是，博韦明确表示，这些指控可能并没有真正消失。

sentences.en: They say the Justice Department is going to dismiss them without prejudice, which means they could bring them back at a later date.
sentences.zh: 他们说司法部将在不附带偏见的情况下撤销指控，这意味着他们以后可能会重新提起诉讼。

sentences.en: And the kind of easy, logical conclusion is, we'll bring them back if you don't help out with this explicit immigration agenda that we're saying we need your help with.
sentences.zh: 一种简单、符合逻辑的推论是：如果你不协助我们明确需要的这个移民议程，我们就会重新起诉。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What some would clearly see as a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 有些人会清楚地将其视为一种利益交换。

sentences.en: And that right there, Michael, is what lays the foundation for the crisis that's now unfolding at the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，正是这一点，为司法部目前正在上演的危机奠定了基础。

sentences.en: Okay, so take us inside that crisis.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么带我们深入了解那场危机。

sentences.en: Beauvais' letter is a call to action for the prosecutors in New York to actually dismiss these charges.
sentences.zh: 博韦的信是向纽约检察官发出的一道行动呼吁，要求他们实际撤销这些指控。

sentences.en: So he needs the people who have built this case, who are overseeing that office, who are career prosecutors not appointed by President Trump, to go along with this plan.
sentences.zh: 因此，他需要那些构建了这个案件、监督那个办公室、并非由特朗普总统任命的职业检察官来配合这个计划。

sentences.en: Charges don't just drop themselves.
sentences.zh: 指控不会自己凭空消失。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And to put it simply, they refuse.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们拒绝了。

sentences.en: The acting U.S.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿的代理联邦

sentences.en: attorney in Manhattan, who is a conservative lawyer named Danielle Sassoon, says that I will resign before I carry out this order.
sentences.zh: 检察官是一位名叫达妮埃尔·萨苏恩的保守派律师，她说宁愿辞职也不执行这项命令。

sentences.en: And in this extraordinary letter to the attorney general, she says, I was sitting in the room when the mayor's lawyers and the Justice Department were working out this deal.
sentences.zh: 在这封写给总检察长的非同寻常的信中，她说：当市长的律师和司法部在敲定这笔交易时，我就坐在房间里。

sentences.en: And basically, the mayor was offering assistance for something in exchange for these charges being dropped.
sentences.zh: 基本上，市长是以提供某种协助来换取这些指控被撤销。

sentences.en: That, in my view, is a quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这就是利益交换。

sentences.en: There's no way that I'm going to be a party to it.
sentences.zh: 我绝不可能成为其中的同谋。

sentences.en: She finishes the letter saying, I remain baffled by the rushed and superficial process by which this decision was reached.
sentences.zh: 她在信的结尾写道：对于达成这一决定的仓促和肤浅的程序，我至今感到困惑。

sentences.en: She's resigning in proteSt.
sentences.zh: 她以辞职抗议。

sentences.en: Yeah, and she's not the only one.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且她不是唯一的一个。

sentences.en: This sets off, basically, a set of dominoes because Emile Beauvais still needs somebody to sign this dismissal paperwork.
sentences.zh: 这基本上引发了一连串的骨牌效应，因为埃米尔·博韦仍然需要有人在撤诉文件上签字。

sentences.en: And he starts hunting around the Justice Department for someone who will.
sentences.zh: 他开始在司法部四处搜寻愿意签字的人。

sentences.en: He goes to the
sentences.zh: 他找到了

sentences.en: Public Integrity Unit in Washington, D.C., which oversees political corruption cases all over the country and says, you guys sign it.
sentences.zh: 位于华盛顿特区的公共诚信部门，该部门负责监督全国各地的政治腐败案件，并说：你们来签字。

sentences.en: The two men who are the acting heads of that department, they go with Sassoon and they say, we're not signing that.
sentences.zh: 该部门的两位代理负责人站在萨苏恩一边，他们说：我们不签。

sentences.en: We quit.
sentences.zh: 我们不干了。

sentences.en: Back in New York, the prosecutor who was overseeing the case preemptively says, nobody's asked me yet, but I'm not doing it either.
sentences.zh: 回到纽约，负责监督此案的检察官先发制人地说：虽然还没人找我，但我也不干这事。

sentences.en: I quit.
sentences.zh: 我不干了。

sentences.en: And he writes another pretty extraordinary letter.
sentences.zh: 他又写了另一封非常不寻常的信。

sentences.en: This is a guy named
sentences.zh: 这个人名叫

sentences.en: Hagan Scotton who had built the case against AdaMs.
sentences.zh: 海根·斯科顿，他曾一手构建了针对亚当斯的案件。

sentences.en: He said, any assistant U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说：任何助理联邦

sentences.en: attorney would know that our laws and traditions do not allow using the prosecutorial power to influence other citizens, much less elected officials in this way.
sentences.zh: 检察官都知道，我们的法律和传统不允许利用检察权去以这种方式影响其他公民，更不用说民选官员了。

sentences.en: If no lawyer within earshot of the president is willing to give him that advice, then I expect you will eventually find someone who is enough of a fool or enough of a coward
sentences.zh: 如果总统身边听得到话的律师里没有一个人愿意给他这个建议，那我预计你最终会找到一个足够愚蠢或足够懦弱的人

sentences.en: to file your motion.
sentences.zh: 来提交你的动议。

sentences.en: But it was never going to be me.
sentences.zh: 但这个人绝不会是我。

sentences.en: So he, just assuming his phone is going to soon ring, writes that letter of resignation saying, I refuse to even be in this seat where I might be asked because I'm so disgusted
sentences.zh: 因此，他仅仅因为预料到自己的电话很快就会响起，就写下了那封辞职信，写道：我拒绝甚至坐在可能会被提出这种要求的座位上，因为我对你们在这里进行的勾当感到如此厌恶。

sentences.en: by what you're undertaking here.
sentences.zh: 司法部的许多人显然也有同感。

sentences.en: And a lot of people at the Justice Department clearly share this opinion.
sentences.zh: 据最新统计，已有八人因亚当斯案和这场争端而辞职。

sentences.en: At the most recent count, eight people have resigned over the Adams case and this dispute.
sentences.zh: 但博韦并没有被吓退。

sentences.en: But Beauvais, he's been undeterred.
sentences.zh: 他向萨苏恩回了一封信，断然否认存在任何利益交换。

sentences.en: He shot back a letter to Sassoon flatly denying that there was any quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 他坚称这里所做的一切都是合法的。

sentences.en: He's maintained that everything that was done here is legal.
sentences.zh: 到上周末，他基本上表示够了。

sentences.en: And by the end of last week, he basically said enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 他把公共诚信部门的一群律师拉进一个电话会议，威胁他们说：总得有人在这东西上签字。

sentences.en: He gets a bunch of lawyers from the Public
sentences.zh: 这极具戏剧性。

sentences.en: Integrity Unit onto a call and threatens them and says, somebody's got to sign this thing.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is incredibly dramatic.
sentences.zh: 因此最终，根据我们的报道显示，该部门的一位高级成员决定把自己的名字签上去，因为流血事件必须在某个地方止住。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他愿意为团队做一次牺牲，心想总得有人来签这个字，但没必要让所有人都因为这场争斗而离职。

sentences.en: And so ultimately, a senior member of that department, our reporting shows, decided to put his name on it because the bleeding had to stop somewhere.
sentences.zh: 所以他决定签字，不是因为他赞同此事，而是因为内讧和辞职潮必须停止。

sentences.en: Basically, he was willing to take one for the team, figured somebody is going to sign this, but not everybody should have to leave over this fight.
sentences.zh: 可以理解，是的。

sentences.en: So he decides to sign it not because he agrees with it, but because the bloodletting, the resignations have to stop.
sentences.zh: 最后，

sentences.en: That's understanding, yes.
sentences.zh: 埃米尔·博韦实际上也将自己的名字签了上去，并将其提交给纽约的一位法官，试图撤销这些指控。

sentences.en: And in the end,
sentences.zh: 因此，所有这些辞职，所有这些戏剧性事件，并没有阻挡他想要的结果。

sentences.en: Emile Beauvais actually puts his name on it as well and it's filed with a judge here in New York to try and dismiss these charges.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，这相当大地改变了公众对这里发生事情的理解，并且可能也改变了法律上的理解。

sentences.zh: 我认为她非常担心这可能会树立的先例。

sentences.en: I mean, at the same time that her constituents are very concerned about President Trump and the Justice Department blasting apart norms and traditions in Washington, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，与此同时，她的选民非常担心特朗普总统和司法部在华盛顿打破规范和传统，你知道，

sentences.en: would this put her in the same position to do that?
sentences.zh: 这会不会把她也置于做同样事情的境地？

sentences.en: And on the other hand, if she really does believe that the mayor is captive to Washington, well,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果她真的相信市长受制于华盛顿，那么，

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: How could she not?
sentences.zh: 她怎么可能不这么想？

sentences.en: So, she's really in a tight position here and I don't think we know yet how she's going to try to get out of it.
sentences.zh: 所以，她在这里确实处于进退两难的境地，我认为我们还不知道她将如何试图摆脱这种困境。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's more or less where things stand at the time we're now taping with you on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们周三录制节目时大致的局势。

sentences.en: The governor is still weighing this.
sentences.zh: 州长仍在权衡此事。

sentences.en: She's indicated serious interest in possibly pursuing this, but ultimately she may decide to just leave this in the hands of the voters and take no action.
sentences.zh: 她表示出认真考虑采取这一行动的兴趣，但最终她可能会决定将此事完全交由选民处理而不采取任何行动。

sentences.en: And so, I want to just put this all together now and ask what you think are the larger lessons of these two crises now that they very much have kind of conjoined.
sentences.zh: 因此，我想把这一切放在一起，问问你认为这两场危机现在既然已经紧密结合，其更深层的教训是什么。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's such an important question, Michael, and it's one that I've been wrestling with a lot over the last several weeks as we've been watching this play out.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的问题，迈克尔，这也是过去几周我们一直在观看事态发展时我一直在纠结的问题。

sentences.en: I'm glad to hear that.
sentences.zh: 很高兴听到这个。

sentences.en: It's your job.
sentences.zh: 这是你的工作。

sentences.en: Now, obviously, both of these crises are open-ended.
sentences.zh: 现在，显然这两场危机都是未完待续的。

sentences.en: We don't know the end yet, but I've been thinking about the first
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道结局，但我一直在回想第一次

sentences.en: Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府时期。

sentences.en: I was based down in Washington then and I wrote a lot about the special counsel's investigation and the aftermath of President Trump firing Jim Comey as FBI director.
sentences.zh: 当时我在华盛顿工作，写了很多关于特别检察官调查以及特朗普总统解雇联邦调查局局长詹姆士·科米之后果的文章。

sentences.en: All of these moments that then felt like break glass moments where he was challenging the norms of the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 所有这些在当时看来像是“打破常规”的时刻，他当时正在挑战司法部的规范。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And here, in just the first few weeks of his administration,
sentences.zh: 而在这里，就在他上任的头几周里，

sentences.en: I think that he's made those tests look quaint.
sentences.zh: 我认为他让以前那些考验显得微不足道了。

sentences.en: Other presidents and attorney generals have been held back in the past by the threats of resignation, by a fear about what might happen if they go just outside the bounds.
sentences.zh: 过去的总统和总检察长曾因辞职威胁、因担心一旦越界会发生什么而受到过约束。

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 那个，

sentences.en: I think Trump is ready to test will anything happen?
sentences.zh: 我认为特朗普已经准备好试探：会发生任何事吗？

sentences.en: If I just blow through this and I really want to do it, can anyone stop me?
sentences.zh: 如果我直接硬闯过去，而且我真的很想这么做，有人能阻止我吗？

sentences.en: The mayor of the nation's largest city is now, whether there was a quid pro quo or not, rowing in the same direction as the president on immigration policy.
sentences.zh: 全美最大城市的市长现在无论是否存在利益交换，在移民政策上都与总统保持着一致的步伐。

sentences.en: He's getting assistance in doing something that he wanted where many other mayors might be putting up a fight.
sentences.zh: 他在做一桩自己梦寐以求、而许多其他市长可能会极力反对的事情时，得到了协助。

sentences.en: And it raises the question down the line, could a Justice Department use prosecutorial power to try and extract other benefits from cities or states by threatening lawsuits,
sentences.zh: 这就引发了一个长远的问题：司法部是否会利用起诉权，通过威胁提起诉讼、

sentences.en: by indicting people, by, you know, pulling them back.
sentences.zh: 通过起诉相关人员，通过，你知道的，把他们撤回来，来试图从城市或州那里榨取其他利益？

sentences.en: That is potentially a very potent tool.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个非常强有力的工具。

sentences.en: This may not be where it ends.
sentences.zh: 这或许还不是终点。

sentences.en: This may be a story that unfolds in Chicago or L.A.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个未来在芝加哥或洛杉矶上演的故事，

sentences.en: in some permutation down the line and just gives Trump basically another arrow in his quiver and they don't have a lot of ability to stop it right now.
sentences.zh: 在未来的某种变体中，这基本上只是给特朗普的箭袋里又添了一支箭，而他们现在并没有多少能力去阻止它。

sentences.en: And just to make very clear what you're saying, because it sounds very important and I haven't thought about it this way, once the president decides that the threat of prosecution
sentences.zh: 为了让你所说的话非常清晰，因为这听起来非常重要，而且我以前没有从这个角度思考过：一旦总统决定将面临起诉的威胁

sentences.en: or taking prosecution away becomes a policy-making tool, then there's no reason not to expect that it's going to be deployed all over the place on all kinds of issues.
sentences.zh: 或者取消起诉变成一项制定政策的工具，那么就没有理由不预料到它将被全面部署到各种各样的问题上去。

sentences.en: The Justice Department may now see the idea of justice as a way of getting policy done.
sentences.zh: 司法部现在可能会把“正义”的概念视为一种达成政策目标的手段。

sentences.en: Exactly, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We have always wondered what it might look like for a president to use the justice system to advance his own ends and his own interests.
sentences.zh: 我们一直想知道，如果一个总统利用司法系统来推进他自己的目的和利益，会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Now we're seeing this administration do that explicitly.
sentences.zh: 现在我们正看着本届政府赤裸裸地这样做。

sentences.en: And I think for people like
sentences.zh: 我想对于像

sentences.en: Danielle Sassoon, the conservative lawyer, prosecutor who resigned in protest, and for the Democrats in New York City who have been watching this unfold, the most concerning thing
sentences.zh: 达妮埃尔·萨松（Danielle Sassoon）——那位愤而辞职的保守派律师、检察官，以及对于那些一直在密切关注这一过程的纽约市民主党人来说，最令人担忧的事

sentences.en: right now
sentences.zh: 情

sentences.en: is that it seems to have worked.
sentences.zh: 在于，它似乎起效了。

sentences.en: Well, Nick, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，尼克，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Wednesday evening,
sentences.zh: 在周三晚上，

sentences.en: Emile Beauvais, the Justice Department official who ordered that charges against Mayor Adams be dropped, issued a stark warning to the department's remaining prosecutors.
sentences.zh: 下令撤销对亚当斯市长指控的司法部官员埃米尔·博韦（Emile Beauvais）向司法部剩下的检察官们发出了严厉的警告。

sentences.en: In a statement,
sentences.zh: 在声明中，

sentences.en: Beauvais told them that they could either work with him to advance
sentences.zh: 博韦告诉他们，要么配合他推进

sentences.en: Trump's agenda on issues like immigration,
sentences.zh: 特朗普在移民等问题上的议程，

sentences.en: or they could resign.
sentences.zh: 要么就辞职。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: In a series of barbed back and forths,
sentences.zh: 在一连串针锋相对的唇枪舌剑中，

sentences.en: Ukrainian President
sentences.zh: 乌克兰总统

sentences.en: Volodymyr Zelensky accused President Trump of buying into
sentences.zh: 弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基指责特朗普总统轻信了

sentences.en: Russian disinformation, and Trump accused Zelensky of being a dictator.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯的虚假信息，而特朗普则指责泽连斯基是个独裁者。

sentences.en: The war of words demonstrated just how quickly the alliance between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这场口水战充分表明，由于

sentences.en: and Ukraine is deteriorating because of
sentences.zh: 特朗普决定拥抱俄罗斯并将泽连斯基排除在结束俄乌战争的会谈之外，美乌

sentences.en: Trump's decision to embrace Russia and cut Zelensky out of talks to end the war between Russia and Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 之间的同盟关系正在以多快的速度恶化。

sentences.en: And the Trump administration says that it plans to revoke federal approval for New York City's new congestion pricing system, which tolls drivers who enter Manhattan's
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府表示，计划撤销对纽约市新拥堵费系统的联邦批准；该系统向进入曼哈顿

sentences.en: busiest streets in order to lower traffic and fund mass transit.
sentences.zh: 最繁忙街道的司机收费，以减少交通拥堵并为公共交通筹集资金。

sentences.en: The White House said it wants to end the program to save working-class drivers the toll's
sentences.zh: 白宫表示，希望结束该项目，以为工薪阶层司机省下这笔

sentences.en: $9 fee.
sentences.zh: 9美元的收费。

sentences.en: But it's unclear whether the president has the authority to shut it down.
sentences.zh: 但目前尚不清楚总统是否有权将其叫停。

sentences.en: I don't care if you love congestion pricing or hate it.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎你是喜欢还是讨厌拥堵费。

sentences.en: This is an attack on our sovereign identity, our independence from Washington.
sentences.zh: 这是对我们主权身份、我们对华盛顿独立性的攻击。

sentences.en: We are not subservient to a king or anyone else out of Washington.
sentences.zh: 我们不依附于华盛顿的国王或任何人。

sentences.en: New York officials said they would fight to preserve the tolls, which so far appear to be succeeding in reducing traffic.
sentences.zh: 纽约官员表示，他们将为维护这些收费而战，这些收费目前看来在减少交通方面取得了成功。

sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线环境，因为这是一件非常具体的事。

sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？
